    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = 6
    markers = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 4]
    template = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    if not markers or not template:
        return out
    # The three-cell vertical sample is centered on its middle cell.
    anchor_r = sorted(r for r, c in template)[len(template) // 2]
    anchor_c = sorted(c for r, c in template)[len(template) // 2]
    offsets = [(r - anchor_r, c - anchor_c) for r, c in template]
    for r, c in markers:
        out[r][c] = background
        for dr, dc in offsets:
            rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= rr < len(out) and 0 <= cc < len(out[0]):
                out[rr][cc] = 5
    return out
